Here is a consolidated, 4-week on-ramp return-to-fitness block that incorporates all adjustments discussed: safe, non-jumping, home + light dumbbells, integrated anti-flexion core, targeted cardio options (low-impact HIIT and steady cardio), diastasis screening guidance, and a cautious return-to-running roadmap layered in. The plan is structured week-by-week with session order, sets/reps, rest, progression cues, and optional cardio/running progressions. Use A/B/C workout structure (adjust as you prefer) and slot the cardio/HIIT and run components as described.

Assumptions and safety reminders
- Client is ~10 weeks postpartum, OB cleared for moderate exercise but no jumping for the next few weeks.
- Equipment: light dumbbells, bodyweight, home setup; optional stationary bike, treadmill, or elliptical if available.
- Core approach: anti-flexion emphasis (no crunches), pelvic floor engaged, rib-pelvis alignment; avoid doming/pain. Stop any exercise if pelvic floor symptoms or diastasis worsens.
- Recovery: monitor sleep, energy, and hunger; stay hydrated; avoid large caloric deficits.

Weekly overview
- Structure: 3 main strength training sessions per week (A, B, C), 1–2 cardio/HIIT sessions, optional mobility work.
- Core: dedicated anti-flexion core work integrated into each week (2–3 core rounds per session as described).
- Running: gradual run-walk progression embedded starting Week 3–4, with safety cues and red flags.
- Diastasis screening: simple at-home checks to monitor progress; adjust loads if doming or widening occurs.

Week 1 – Acclimatisation + foundational anti-flexion core
Goals: re-establish routine, retrain pelvic floor activation, low-load technique, light cardio acclimation.

Sessions (3 strength days)
Session A – Full body, low load with light intro to core
- Warm-up: 6–8 minutes light cardio (marching in place, arm circles, hip circles)
- Goblet Squat (light dumbbell or bodyweight, tempo 2-0-2)
  - 3 sets x 12 reps
- Hip Hinge to Romanian Deadlift (dumbbells, neutral spine)
  - 3 x 12
- Dumbbell Row (single-arm or double-arm, light)
  - 3 x 12 per arm
- Glute Bridge (bodyweight or with dumbbell on hips)
  - 3 x 15
- Core: Anti-flexion circuit (2 rounds)
  - Bird-Dog hold, 2 x 30 seconds per side
  - Dead Bug, 2 x 10 per side
  - Pallof press (standing, light) 2 x 30 seconds
- Mobility: 5 minutes (hip flexor, thoracic spine)

Session B – Lower body emphasis
- Warm-up: 6–8 minutes
- Split Squat (forward or reverse) with light dumbbells
  - 3 x 10 per leg
- Dumbbell Deadlift to High Row (light)
  - 3 x 12
- Step-Ups (low height)
  - 3 x 12 per leg
- Glute Bridge March
  - 3 x 12 per leg
- Core: Anti-flexion set
  - Pallof press 2 x 30–40 seconds
  - Side plank (modified) 2 x 20–30 seconds per side
- Mobility: 5 minutes (ankle/hip)

Session C – Upper body emphasis
- Warm-up: 6–8 minutes
- Dumbbell Floor Press (or incline if possible)
  - 3 x 12
- Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press (light)
  - 3 x 12
- Dumbbell Bent-Over Row (both arms)
  - 3 x 12
- Bicep Curl to Tricep Kickback (super-set)
  - 3 x 12 each
- Core: Anti-rotation work
  - Pallof press 2 x 30 seconds; 1–2 rounds of anti-rotation hold
- Mobility: 5 minutes (thoracic spine rotation, pec stretch)
